name: Ultra Ethernet Consortium: UE Specification 1.0.3 and 1.0 white paper
notes: UEC site publishing UE Specification 1.0.3 and the 1.0 white paper. UEC is an Ethernet-based open, interoperable full-communications stack for AI and HPC scale-out, hosted under the Linux Foundation. Members include AMD, Arista, Broadcom, Cisco, HPE, Intel, Meta, Microsoft, Alibaba Cloud, Google Cloud, Huawei and ZTE.
